options.help: 启用 [窗口置顶]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Make scrcpy window always on top (above other windows).

options.help: 设置 [自定义画面角度]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Rotate the video content by a custom angle, in degrees (clockwise).

options.help: 设置 [音频比特率]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Encode the audio at the given bit rate, expressed in bits/s. Unit suffixes are supported: 'K' (x1000) and 'M' (x1000000). Default is 128K (128000).

options.help: 设置 [音频缓冲]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure the audio buffering delay (in milliseconds). Lower values decrease the latency, but increase the likelihood of buffer underrun (causing audio glitches). Default is 50.

options.help: 设置 [音频编码格式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select an audio codec (opus, aac, flac or raw). Default is opus.

options.help: 设置 [音频编码器选项]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set a list of comma-separated key:type=value options for the device audio encoder. The possible values for 'type' are 'int' (default), 'long', 'float' and 'string'. The list of possible codec options is available in the Android documentation: <https://d.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaFormat>

options.help: 启用 [设备端保留播放]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Duplicate audio (capture and keep playing on the device). This feature is only available with --audio-source=playback.

options.help: 设置 [音频编码器]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Use a specific MediaCodec audio encoder (depending on the codec provided by --audio-codec). The available encoders can be listed by --list-encoders.

options.help: 设置 [SDL 音频输出缓冲]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure the size of the SDL audio output buffer (in milliseconds). Do not change this setting unless you have a good reason. Default is 10.

options.help: 设置 [音频来源]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select the audio source. Possible values are: - "output": forwards the whole audio output, and disables playback on the device. - "playback": captures the audio playback (Android apps can opt-out, so the whole output is not necessarily captured). - "mic": captures the microphone. - "mic-unprocessed": captures the microphone unprocessed (raw) sound. - "mic-camcorder": captures the microphone tuned for video recording, with the same orientation as the camera if available. - "mic-voice-recognition": captures the microphone tuned for voice recognition. - "mic-voice-communication": captures the microphone tuned for voice communications (it will for instance take advantage of echo cancellation or automatic gain control if available). - "voice-call": captures voice call. - "voice-call-uplink": captures voice call uplink only. - "voice-call-downlink": captures voice call downlink only. - "voice-performance": captures audio meant to be processed for live performance (karaoke), includes both the microphone and the device playback. Default is output.

options.help: 设置 [虚拟显示背景色]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the background color, encoded as hexadecimal color code (#RGB or #RRGGBB). Default is #222 (dark gray).

options.help: 设置 [相机宽高比]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select the camera size by its aspect ratio (+/- 10%). Possible values are "sensor" (use the camera sensor aspect ratio), "<num>:<den>" (e.g. "4:3") or "<value>" (e.g. "1.6").

options.help: 设置 [相机朝向]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select the device camera by its facing direction. Possible values are "front", "back" and "external".

options.help: 设置 [相机帧率]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify the camera capture frame rate. If not specified, Android's default frame rate (30 fps) is used.

options.help: 启用 [高速相机模式]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Enable high-speed camera capture mode. This mode is restricted to specific resolutions and frame rates, listed by --list-camera-sizes.

options.help: 设置 [相机 ID]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify the device camera id to mirror. The available camera ids can be listed by: scrcpy --list-cameras

options.help: 设置 [相机尺寸]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify an explicit camera capture size.

options.help: 启用 [启动相机补光灯]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Turn on the camera torch when the camera starts.

options.help: 设置 [相机初始缩放]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify the camera zoom initial value.

options.help: 设置 [捕获方向]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the capture video orientation. Possible values are 0, 90, 180, 270, flip0, flip90, flip180 and flip270, possibly prefixed by '@'. The number represents the clockwise rotation in degrees; the flip" keyword applies a horizontal flip before the rotation. If a leading '@' is passed (@90) for display capture, then the rotation is locked, and is relative to the natural device orientation. If '@' is passed alone, then the rotation is locked to the initial device orientation. Default is 0.

options.help: 设置 [画面裁剪]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Crop the device screen on the server. The values are expressed in the device natural orientation (typically, portrait for a phone, landscape for a tablet).

options.help: 启用 [运行时禁用屏保]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable screensaver while scrcpy is running.

options.help: 设置 [显示器 ID]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify the device display id to mirror. The available display ids can be listed by: scrcpy --list-displays Default is 0.

options.help: 设置 [输入法显示策略]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the policy for selecting where the IME should be displayed. Possible values are "local", "fallback" and "hide". "local" means that the IME should appear on the local display. "fallback" means that the IME should appear on a fallback display (the default display). "hide" means that the IME should be hidden.

options.help: 设置 [显示方向]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the initial display orientation. Possible values are 0, 90, 180, 270, flip0, flip90, flip180 and flip270. The number represents the clockwise rotation in degrees; the "flip" keyword applies a horizontal flip before the rotation. Default is 0.

options.chineseTitle: 窗口联动虚拟显示尺寸
options.help: 启用 [窗口联动虚拟显示尺寸]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Continuously resize the virtual display to match the window.

options.help: 启用 [强制 ADB forward]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Do not attempt to use "adb reverse" to connect to the device.

options.help: 启用 [全屏启动]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Start in fullscreen.

options.help: 设置 [手柄输入模式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select how to send gamepad inputs to the device. Possible values are "disabled", "uhid" and "aoa". "disabled" does not send gamepad inputs to the device. "uhid" simulates physical HID gamepads using the Linux UHID kernel module on the device. "aoa" simulates physical gamepads using the AOAv2 protocol.It may only work over USB. Also see --keyboard and --mouse.

options.help: 启用 [忽略视频编码器约束]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Do not consider video encoder capabilities. This is useful if the reported capabilities are incorrect. It may help to force a value for --min-size-alignment.

options.help: 启用 [保持设备活跃]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Keep the screen on by simulating user activity.

options.help: 设置 [键盘输入模式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select how to send keyboard inputs to the device. Possible values are "disabled", "sdk", "uhid" and "aoa". "disabled" does not send keyboard inputs to the device. "sdk" uses the Android system API to deliver keyboard events to applications. "uhid" simulates a physical HID keyboard using the Linux UHID kernel module on the device. "aoa" simulates a physical keyboard using the AOAv2 protocol. It may only work over USB. For "uhid" and "aoa", the keyboard layout must be configured (once and for all) on the device, via Settings -> System -> Languages and input -> Physical keyboard. This settings page can be started directly using the shortcut MOD+k (except in OTG mode) or by executing: `adb shell am start -a android.settings.HARD_KEYBOARD_SETTINGS`. This option is only available when a HID keyboard is enabled (or a physical keyboard is connected). Also see --mouse and --gamepad.

options.help: 启用 [关闭时结束 ADB]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Kill adb when scrcpy terminates.

options.help: 启用 [旧版粘贴方式]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Inject computer clipboard text as a sequence of key events on Ctrl+v (like MOD+Shift+v). This is a workaround for some devices not behaving as expected when setting the device clipboard programmatically.

options.help: 设置 [最大帧率]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Limit the frame rate of screen capture (officially supported since Android 10, but may work on earlier versions).

options.help: 设置 [最大画面尺寸]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Limit both the width and height of the video. For display mirroring, the other dimension is computed so that the device aspect ratio is preserved (except for flex displays). For camera mirroring, the value is used to select the camera source size instead. Default is 0 (unlimited).

options.help: 设置 [最小尺寸对齐]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure the minimum video size alignment. This is a power-of-2 value (1, 2, 4, 8 or 16) that the video width and height must be multiples of. The actual alignment will be the maximum of this value and the video codec's alignment requirement. Default is 1.

options.help: 设置 [鼠标输入模式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select how to send mouse inputs to the device. Possible values are "disabled", "sdk", "uhid" and "aoa". "disabled" does not send mouse inputs to the device. "sdk" uses the Android system API to deliver mouse eventsto applications. "uhid" simulates a physical HID mouse using the Linux UHID kernel module on the device. "aoa" simulates a physical mouse using the AOAv2 protocol. It may only work over USB. In "uhid" and "aoa" modes, the computer mouse is captured to control the device directly (relative mouse mode). LAlt, LSuper or RSuper toggle the capture mode, to give control of the mouse back to the computer. Also see --keyboard and --gamepad.

options.help: 设置 [鼠标辅助键绑定]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure bindings of secondary clicks. The argument must be one or two sequences (separated by ':') of exactly 4 characters, one for each secondary click (in order: right click, middle click, 4th click, 5th click). The first sequence defines the primary bindings, used when a mouse button is pressed alone. The second sequence defines the secondary bindings, used when a mouse button is pressed while the Shift key is held. If the second sequence of bindings is omitted, then it is the same as the first one. Each character must be one of the following: '+': forward the click to the device '-': ignore the click 'b': trigger shortcut BACK (or turn screen on if off) 'h': trigger shortcut HOME 's': trigger shortcut APP_SWITCH 'n': trigger shortcut "expand notification panel" Default is 'bhsn:++++' for SDK mouse, and '++++:bhsn' for AOA and UHID.

options.help: 设置 [新建虚拟显示器]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Create a new display with the specified resolution and density. If not provided, they default to the main display dimensions and DPI. Examples: --new-display=1920x1080 --new-display=1920x1080/420  # force 420 dpi --new-display         # main display size and density --new-display=/240    # main display size and 240 dpi

options.help: 启用 [禁用音频转发]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable audio forwarding.

options.help: 启用 [禁用本机音频播放]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable audio playback on the computer.

options.chineseTitle: 退出时不清理设备状态
options.help: 启用 [退出时不清理设备状态]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: By default, scrcpy removes the server binary from the device and restores the device state (show touches, stay awake and power mode) on exit. This option disables this cleanup.

options.help: 启用 [禁用剪贴板自动同步]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: By default, scrcpy automatically synchronizes the computer clipboard to the device clipboard before injecting Ctrl+v, and the device clipboard to the computer clipboard whenever it changes. This option disables this automatic synchronization.

options.help: 启用 [禁用设备控制]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable device control (mirror the device in read-only).

options.chineseTitle: 编码失败时不自动降分辨率
options.help: 启用 [编码失败时不自动降分辨率]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: By default, on MediaCodec error, scrcpy automatically tries again with a lower definition. This option disables this behavior.

options.help: 启用 [禁用按键重复]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Do not forward repeated key events when a key is held down.

options.help: 启用 [禁用 Mipmap]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: If the renderer is OpenGL 3.0+ or OpenGL ES 2.0+, then mipmaps are automatically generated to improve downscaling quality. This option disables the generation of mipmaps.

options.help: 启用 [禁用鼠标悬停事件]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Do not forward mouse hover (mouse motion without any clicks) events.

options.help: 启用 [禁用全部本机播放]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable video and audio playback on the computer (equivalent to --no-video-playback --no-audio-playback).

options.help: 启用 [启动时不唤醒设备]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Do not power on the device on start.

options.help: 启用 [禁用终端标题更新]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable terminal title updates.

options.chineseTitle: 虚拟显示移除时保留内容
options.help: 启用 [虚拟显示移除时保留内容]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable virtual display "destroy content on removal" flag. With this option, when the virtual display is closed, the running apps are moved to the main display rather than being destroyed.

options.chineseTitle: 虚拟显示不显示系统装饰
options.help: 启用 [虚拟显示不显示系统装饰]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable virtual display system decorations flag.

options.help: 启用 [禁用视频转发]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable video forwarding.

options.help: 启用 [禁用本机视频播放]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable video playback on the computer.

options.help: 启用 [不创建投屏窗口]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable scrcpy window. Implies --no-video-playback.

options.help: 启用 [不锁定窗口宽高比]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable window aspect ratio lock.

options.help: 设置 [统一显示与录制方向]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Same as --display-orientation=value --record-orientation=value.

options.help: 启用 [OTG 模式]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Run in OTG mode: simulate physical keyboard and mouse, as if the computer keyboard and mouse were plugged directly to the device via an OTG cable. In this mode, adb (USB debugging) is not necessary, and mirroring is disabled. LAlt, LSuper or RSuper toggle the mouse capture mode, to give control of the mouse back to the computer. Keyboard and mouse may be disabled separately using--keyboard=disabled and --mouse=disabled. It may only work over USB. See --keyboard, --mouse and --gamepad.

options.help: 设置 [退出时暂停终端]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure pause on exit. Possible values are "true" (always pause on exit), "false" (never pause on exit) and "if-error" (pause only if an error occurred). This is useful to prevent the terminal window from automatically closing, so that error messages can be read. Default is "false". Passing the option without argument is equivalent to passing "true".

options.help: 设置 [客户端监听端口范围]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the TCP port (range) used by the client to listen. Default is 27183:27199.

options.help: 启用 [关闭时熄灭设备屏幕]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Turn the device screen off when closing scrcpy.

options.help: 启用 [优先注入文本事件]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Inject alpha characters and space as text events instead of key events. This avoids issues when combining multiple keys to enter a special character, but breaks the expected behavior of alpha keys in games (typically WASD).

options.help: 启用 [输出 FPS]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Start FPS counter, to print framerate logs to the console. It can be started or stopped at any time with MOD+i.

options.help: 设置 [拖放文件目标目录]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the target directory for pushing files to the device by drag & drop. It is passed as is to "adb push". Default is "/sdcard/Download/".

options.help: 启用 [仅注入原始按键事件]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Inject key events for all input keys, and ignore text events.

options.help: 设置 [录制文件]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Record screen to file. The format is determined by the --record-format option if set, or by the file extension.

options.help: 设置 [录制格式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Force recording format (mp4, mkv, m4a, mka, opus, aac, flac or wav).

options.help: 设置 [录制方向]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the record orientation. Possible values are 0, 90, 180 and 270. The number represents the clockwise rotation in degrees. Default is 0.

options.help: 设置 [SDL 渲染驱动]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Request SDL to use the given render driver (this is just a hint). Supported names are currently "direct3d", "opengl", "opengles2", "opengles", "metal" and "software". <https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL_HINT_RENDER_DRIVER>

options.help: 设置 [画面适配模式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the render-fit mode to configure how the rendering fits the window. Possible values are "letterbox", "stretched" and "unscaled". "letterbox": preserve the aspect ratio and fit the window as best as possible (black bars are added either at the top and bottom or at the sides if needed). "stretched": fit the window without preserving the aspect ratio. "unscaled": render the display without scaling. Default is "letterbox", unless --flex-display is set, in which case it is "unscaled".

options.help: 启用 [音频失败时终止]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: By default, scrcpy mirrors only the video when audio capture fails on the device. This option makes scrcpy fail if audio is enabled but does not work.

options.help: 设置 [设备熄屏超时]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the screen off timeout while scrcpy is running (restore the initial value on exit).

options.chineseTitle: 自动选择 TCP/IP 设备
options.help: 启用 [自动选择 TCP/IP 设备]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Use TCP/IP device (if there is exactly one, like adb -e). Also see -d (--select-usb).

options.chineseTitle: 自动选择 USB 设备
options.help: 启用 [自动选择 USB 设备]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Use USB device (if there is exactly one, like adb -d). Also see -e (--select-tcpip).

options.help: 设置 [设备序列号]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: The device serial number. Mandatory only if several devices are connected to adb.

options.help: 设置 [快捷键修饰键]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Specify the modifiers to use for scrcpy shortcuts. Possible keys are "lctrl", "rctrl", "lalt", "ralt", "lsuper" and "rsuper". Several shortcut modifiers can be specified, separated by ','. For example, to use either LCtrl or LSuper for scrcpy shortcuts, pass "lctrl,lsuper". Default is "lalt,lsuper" (left-Alt or left-Super).

options.help: 启用 [显示物理触摸点]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Enable "show touches" on start, restore the initial value on exit. It only shows physical touches (not clicks from scrcpy).

options.help: 设置 [启动 Android 应用]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Start an Android app, by its exact package name. Add a '?' prefix to select an app whose name starts with the given name, case-insensitive (retrieving app names on the device may take some time): scrcpy --start-app=?firefox Add a '+' prefix to force-stop before starting the app: scrcpy --new-display --start-app=+org.mozilla.firefox Both prefixes can be used, in that order: scrcpy --start-app=+?firefox

options.help: 启用 [保持设备唤醒]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Keep the device on while scrcpy is running, when the device is plugged in.

options.help: 设置 [配置并连接 TCP/IP]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Configure and connect the device over TCP/IP. If a destination address is provided, then scrcpy connects to this address before starting. The device must listen on the given TCP port (default is 5555). If no destination address is provided, then scrcpy attempts to find the IP address of the current device (typically connected over USB), enables TCP/IP mode, then connects to this address before starting. Prefix the address with a '+' to force a reconnection.

options.help: 设置 [会话时长上限]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the maximum mirroring time, in seconds.

options.help: 设置 [ADB 隧道主机]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the IP address of the adb tunnel to reach the scrcpy server. This option automatically enables --force-adb-forward. Default is localhost.

options.help: 设置 [ADB 隧道端口]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the TCP port of the adb tunnel to reach the scrcpy server. This option automatically enables --force-adb-forward. Default is 0 (not forced): the local port used for establishing the tunnel will be used.

options.help: 启用 [启动后关闭设备屏幕]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Turn the device screen off immediately.

options.help: 设置 [日志级别]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the log level (verbose, debug, info, warn or error). Default is info.

options.help: 设置 [视频比特率]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Encode the video at the given bit rate, expressed in bits/s. Unit suffixes are supported: 'K' (x1000) and 'M' (x1000000). Default is 8M (8000000).

options.help: 设置 [视频缓冲]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Add a buffering delay (in milliseconds) before displaying video frames. This increases latency to compensate for jitter. Default is 0 (no buffering).

options.help: 设置 [视频编码格式]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select a video codec (h264, h265, av1, vp8 or vp9). Default is h264.

options.help: 设置 [视频编码器选项]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set a list of comma-separated key:type=value options for the device video encoder. The possible values for 'type' are 'int' (default), 'long', 'float' and 'string'. The list of possible codec options is available in the Android documentation: <https://d.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaFormat>

options.help: 设置 [视频编码器]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Use a specific MediaCodec video encoder (depending on the codec provided by --video-codec). The available encoders can be listed by --list-encoders.

options.help: 设置 [视频来源]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Select the video source (display or camera). Camera mirroring requires Android 12+. Default is display.

options.help: 启用 [无边框窗口]。关闭时沿用 scrcpy 默认行为。
options.officialHelp: Disable window decorations (display borderless window).

options.help: 设置 [初始窗口高度]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the initial window height. Default is 0 (automatic).

options.help: 设置 [窗口标题]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set a custom window title.

options.help: 设置 [初始窗口宽度]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the initial window width. Default is 0 (automatic).

options.help: 设置 [初始窗口横坐标]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the initial window horizontal position. Default is "auto".

options.help: 设置 [初始窗口纵坐标]。未启用时沿用 scrcpy 默认值。
options.officialHelp: Set the initial window vertical position. Default is "auto".
